plan.title: feat(scope,doctor): fail closed when completed lifecycle disagrees with plan.status or open plan.items

narratives.Description: Lifecycle can report a scope completed while plan.items remain pending or plan.status disagrees with the completed folder. Epic #3237 Q4 locked a simple rule: completed folder, matching plan.status, and terminal plan.items only.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want doctor and scope:complete to fail closed when a completed scope still has open plan items or mismatched plan.status, so that lifecycle cannot report done with an open checklist.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add a verifier used by scope:complete and doctor (packages/core/src/scope and packages/core/src/lifecycle or doctor checks) that fails closed when xbrief/completed/* has plan.status other than completed, or any plan.items entry is non-terminal. Print exact artifact paths and statuses. Do not couple history/changes. Tests under packages/core/src/scope and lifecycle. Run vitest and task check. Cite #3242 in CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Overview: feat(scope,doctor): fail closed when completed lifecycle disagrees with plan.status or open plan.items
narratives.NonGoals: Out of issue scope; see epic #3237 current-shape.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Acceptance items from locked epic contracts.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a file in xbrief/completed with plan.status=running, when doctor or the complete verifier runs, it fails closed naming the path and both statuses.
Given plan.items with a pending entry, when scope:complete runs, it exits non-zero.
Given completed folder, plan.status=completed, and all items terminal, when the verifier runs, this check is green.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/scope packages/core/src/lifecycle packages/core/src/doctor
swarm.acceptance_criteria_justification: Items map to locked contracts / issue AC.
